features.title: Deterministic tabletop RPG game master for Hermes group chats

product_gate.user: D&D 5e players using Hermes in a Discord or Telegram group
product_gate.buyer: Hermes users who run tabletop sessions in group chats
product_gate.job: Run a shared campaign without trusting the language model to resolve mechanics
product_gate.verb: roll and resolve an owned character's turn
product_gate.wedge: code-authoritative dice, ownership, initiative and persistent campaign state inside a Hermes chat turn
product_gate.direct_alternative: Avrae Discord bot and tabletop virtual tabletops
product_gate.new_capability: Hermes narrates a group-chat campaign while a plugin enforces mechanics and player ownership from tool calls
product_gate.kill_shot: Existing Discord RPG bots already resolve rules, so this only matters if users specifically want Hermes narration with code-verifiable resolution
evidence: BRIEF.md defines target runtime and required deterministic mechanics
Hermes plugin docs expose register_tool, hooks, plugin data storage and slash commands
Avrae is the direct Discord alternative; feature fit must be proven by the requested integration, not assumed
